entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Official Over-the-Air (OTA) App Patching Support in .NET (Similar to Flutter Shorebird) #40454
  • Calling PickAsync on Android Disconnects Debugger #40451
  • [Android] OrientationStateTrigger stays subscribed to DeviceDisplay after the Activity is recreated, leaking the old page through its setters #40450
  • [iOS] "Window was already destroyed" on every force-close when MainPage is used with UIScene lifecycle (now mandatory with iOS 27 SDK) #40438
  • [Android] Custom pin icons on Map are scaled down #40435
  • Shadow update can access a disposed DropShadow after disconnect/reconnect leads to Crash #40432
  • [iOS, Mac] Horizontal CollectionView resets to the beginning when RefreshView is triggered programmatically #40422
  • ImageSourcePartLoader loses cancellation ownership when an older load completes #40421
  • [PR Review Queue] 2026-11-19 #40416
  • [Android] Material 3 Switch briefly flashes primary color when turned off #40415
  • [Windows][.NET 11] CollectionViewHandler2 does not display grouped CollectionView items #40414
  • XAML Hot Reload Does Not Work in .NET11 #40413
  • [repo-status] Daily repo status — 2026-11-19 🌟 #40411
